instructions: Rinse 1 1/2 cups basmati rice until the water runs mostly clear. Add it to a medium pot with 2 1/4 cups water and 1/2 tsp of the salt, bring to a boil over high heat, then cover, turn the heat to low and cook for 12 minutes. Leave it covered off the heat until you serve.
Slice the eggplant into 1/2-inch rounds and cut any wide ones in half. Put them in a colander, toss with 1 tsp salt and leave them for 15 minutes.

Meanwhile, toast 1 tsp of the cumin seeds in a dry small skillet over medium heat for about 1 minute, until they smell toasty. Transfer them into a bowl and crush them coarsely with the back of a spoon.
Add the yogurt, sugar and 1/2 tsp salt to the cumin and whisk until smooth.
Pat the eggplant dry with a towel and toss it with the turmeric.

Heat 1 1/2 tbsp of the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add half the eggplant in a single layer and cook for 3 to 4 minutes on each side, until browned and soft in the middle. Transfer to a plate and repeat with another 1 1/2 tbsp oil and the rest of the eggplant.

Heat the last 1 tbsp oil in the small skillet over medium heat. Add the mustard seeds. When they start to pop, after about 20 seconds, add the remaining 1/4 tsp cumin seeds and the curry leaves. Stand back a little, they'll spatter. Stir in the chili powder and take the pan off the heat.
Stir two thirds of the tempered oil into the yogurt.
Spread half the yogurt on a platter, lay half the eggplant on it, then repeat with the rest. Drizzle the remaining tempered oil over the top.
method_notes: No version of doi begun has 20 ratings. Playful Cooking leads (no ratings listed): salted eggplant fried until browned, layered with cumin and sugar yogurt, and finished with a mustard seed and curry leaf tempering. Plattershare (4.67 from 6) has a cooked yogurt gravy and My Spice Trunk (no ratings) uses panch phoran, so the sweet, uncooked yogurt of the lead was kept. Hebbar's dahi baingan (5.0 from 269) is a savory cousin and was not used. Eggplant amount set by us since the lead leaves it out.
